title: Unprecedented Spike in Spyware Alerts for Apple Users Worldwide
description:
In August 2026, Apple reported an unprecedented number of users receiving 'threat notifications' regarding potential spyware attacks. Investigators revealed that alerts were sent to users in 110 countries, marking a significant increase in reported cases. The notifications, which Apple has issued since 2021, are designed to inform users targeted by spyware capable of compromising their devices. Access Now, an international nonprofit, noted a record number of individuals seeking assistance following these alerts, with a 30-40% rise compared to previous notifications. Among those affected are Ukrainian soldiers, who initially doubted the legitimacy of the alerts but later confirmed their authenticity with Apple. Experts suggest that the increase in notifications may be attributed to Apple adopting new methods for alerting users. The situation indicates a broader trend of spyware targeting individuals across various sectors, raising concerns about user safety and privacy.

Key Points:
• Apple users in 110 countries received unprecedented spyware alerts in August 2026.
• Access Now reported a 30-40% increase in requests for assistance following the notifications.
• Ukrainian soldiers were among those targeted, confirming the alerts' legitimacy with Apple.
